name: Jens Kristensen
bio:
Jens Kristensen discovered his passion for motorsport through his father, a seasoned rally mechanic. Growing up in a small town known for its karting circuit, Jens spent his youth tinkering with engines and perfecting paint finishes on anything he could get his hands on. His dedication led him to an apprenticeship at a local body shop before landing a coveted position with Team Gtechniq.

Jens is known for his meticulous approach to paint application, believing that a flawless finish is crucial for both aesthetics and aerodynamic performance. He's constantly researching new techniques and materials to improve the team's overall performance. While his high standards can be demanding, his unwavering commitment to excellence makes him an invaluable asset.

What truly sets Jens apart is his ability to blend traditional methods with innovative solutions. He's not afraid to experiment with new coatings and application techniques, often pushing the boundaries of what's possible in motorsport paint technology. His reputation for delivering exceptional results precedes him, making him highly sought after within the racing community.
